retrievalProfile.description: A moody urban portrait featuring a male subject in a dark hoodie against an industrial alleyway with stacked slab-serif typography.
excludeWhen: clean minimalist studio backgrounds are needed
sans-serif modernism is the primary goal

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a young man in a black hoodie looking off-camera, positioned on the left third of the frame. The background is a receding perspective of an industrial alley with corrugated metal doors and brick walls. The right side features a vertically stacked typographic block with horizontal rule lines.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject on the left balances the text block on the right
Receding alley lines create depth behind the flat text
Dark clothing contrasts with the lighter industrial textures
Horizontal rules in text echo the horizontal lines of the garage doors
coreInvariants: Three-tier typographic hierarchy separated by horizontal lines
Industrial alleyway perspective with a vanishing point on the right
Muted, slightly desaturated color palette with cool shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left 40% of the frame, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large primary name text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down his arm, then across to the right-aligned text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The alleyway floor and upper sky provide breathing room for the dense central composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted olive and grey industrial tones in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the hoodie against the lighter concrete.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Crisp white for all typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on tonal contrast between shadows and highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses heavy, wide slab serifs with slight distressing
Secondary text uses a bold, extended sans-serif
Tertiary text uses a light, tracked-out sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars extending from the edges of the text block to create a framed effect
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a heavy slab serif with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for a balanced industrial look.
graphicDevices: Text block alignment to the right third

avoid: Serif fonts with high contrast like Bodoni

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, geometric slab serif of the primary name.
Captures the small-serif feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a young man in a black hoodie standing in a gritty, industrial alleyway with corrugated metal doors, looking away from the camera. Leave the right side of the frame clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of white uppercase text on the right. Top level: Large slab serif. Middle level: Bold sans-serif. Bottom level: Light sans-serif. Separate levels with thin horizontal white lines.

verificationChecks: Are there horizontal lines between the text rows?
Is the primary font a heavy slab serif?
Is the background an industrial alleyway?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or logos
postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab serif is sufficiently heavy.
Ensure the horizontal lines are perfectly straight.
Verify the subject is not centered.
Confirm the color palette remains muted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Industrial Perspective + Stacked Slab-Serif Typography with Rule Lines
